resource.description: Primary tumor, right lower lobe of lung

resource.conclusion: 4 cm right lower lobe mass. Right hilar fullness. No pleural effusion. Recommend CT chest.

coding.display: CT Chest and Abdomen and Pelvis W contrast IV

resource.conclusion: Spiculated 4.3 x 3.6 cm right lower lobe mass. Enlarged right hilar lymph nodes (short axis up to 1.6 cm); no mediastinal or contralateral hilar adenopathy. Multiple bilateral pulmonary nodules up to 0.9 cm, including four in the left lung, suspicious for metastases. Lytic lesions in the left ilium (3.1 cm), T10 vertebral body and right 6th rib. Liver, adrenals unremarkable. No pleural or pericardial effusion.

coding.display: PET+CT Guidance for localization of tumor of Skull base to mid-thigh-- W 18F-FDG IV

resource.conclusion: FDG-avid right lower lobe mass (SUVmax 12.4) and right hilar nodes (SUVmax 6.8). Bilateral FDG-avid pulmonary nodules. FDG-avid osseous metastases: left ilium (SUVmax 9.7), T10, right 6th rib. No FDG-avid mediastinal, hepatic or adrenal disease.

coding.display: MR Brain WO and W contrast IV

resource.conclusion: No evidence of intracranial metastatic disease.

Right lower lobe mass, CT-guided FNA: non-small cell carcinoma, consistent with adenocarcinoma. Immunostains on cell block: TTF-1 positive, Napsin A positive, p40 negative. Cell block adequate for ancillary studies (PD-L1 and molecular testing sent).
Left iliac bone lesion, CT-guided core biopsy: metastatic adenocarcinoma, TTF-1 positive, morphologically similar to the right lower lobe FNA, consistent with a lung primary.

Initial tumor genomic profiling (RLL FNA cell block, targeted NGS): EGFR exon 21 L858R detected. No ALK, ROS1, RET or NTRK fusions; no MET exon 14 skipping; KRAS and BRAF wild type. Detailed variant-level results are maintained on the genomics server, not in this report.

coding.display: CT Chest and Abdomen and Pelvis W contrast IV

resource.conclusion: Continued decrease in right lower lobe mass, now 2.1 x 1.7 cm (nadir). Right hilar nodes normal in size. Pulmonary nodules resolved or decreased. Sclerotic (treated) osseous metastases. No new disease.

coding.display: CT Chest and Abdomen and Pelvis W contrast IV

resource.conclusion: Progression of disease. Right lower lobe mass enlarged to 3.4 x 2.8 cm (from nadir 2.1 x 1.7 cm). Two new hypoattenuating liver lesions in segments 6 (2.4 cm) and 7 (1.5 cm), consistent with metastases. New 1.1 cm left lower lobe nodule. Osseous metastases stable and sclerotic. No new bone lesions.

coding.display: MR Brain WO and W contrast IV

resource.conclusion: No evidence of intracranial metastatic disease.

Liver segment 6 lesion, CT-guided core biopsy: metastatic adenocarcinoma, TTF-1 positive, consistent with the known lung primary. No small cell or squamous transformation identified. Tissue sent for repeat comprehensive genomic profiling.
